sql: SELECT t.*, a.account_name, a.account_tier, a.duns_number, a.account_owner, a.owner_email, c.erp_customer_id, c.customer_name FROM service_tickets t JOIN crm_accounts a ON a.account_id=t.account_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.duns_number=a.duns_number WHERE t.ticket_id='SR-39561'
gated_sql: SELECT t.*, a.account_name, a.account_tier, a.duns_number, a.account_owner, a.owner_email, c.erp_customer_id, c.customer_name FROM service_tickets AS t JOIN crm_accounts AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN customers AS c ON c.duns_number = a.duns_number WHERE t.ticket_id = 'SR-39561' LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT at, event, actor, detail FROM ticket_events WHERE ticket_id='SR-39561' ORDER BY julianday(at)
gated_sql: SELECT at, event, actor, detail FROM ticket_events WHERE ticket_id = 'SR-39561' ORDER BY JULIANDAY(at) LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT * FROM maintenance_notices WHERE account_id='CRM-2051' ORDER BY julianday(window_start)
gated_sql: SELECT * FROM maintenance_notices WHERE account_id = 'CRM-2051' ORDER BY JULIANDAY(window_start) LIMIT 200

sql: SELECT o.ticket_id, o.opened_at, o.product_sku, o.status, o.restored_at, o.description, (SELECT group_concat(credit_id||':'||amount_usd||':'||approved_on) FROM service_credits s WHERE s.ticket_id=o.ticket_id) cr FROM service_tickets o WHERE account_id='CRM-2051' ORDER BY julianday(opened_at)
gated_sql: SELECT o.ticket_id, o.opened_at, o.product_sku, o.status, o.restored_at, o.description, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(credit_id || ':' || amount_usd || ':' || approved_on) FROM service_credits AS s WHERE s.ticket_id = o.ticket_id) AS cr FROM service_tickets AS o WHERE account_id = 'CRM-2051' ORDER BY JULIANDAY(opened_at) LIMIT 200
